scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate a media binding id in the StreamingAssets manifest.

diagnostics.message: Media binding ids must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Bind staged media to a family id outside the Goal 047/053/054 families.

diagnostics.message: Family id must resolve to a selected source family.

scenarios.causalMutation: Bind staged media to a slot id absent from Goal 054 materialized media.

diagnostics.message: Slot id must resolve to a Goal 054 source slot.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit a proof line for media not present in the StreamingAssets manifest.

diagnostics.message: Unity proof lines must be derived from staged manifest records.

scenarios.causalMutation: Promote a blocked license/provenance candidate into the staged package.

diagnostics.message: Blocked license/provenance candidates cannot enter the playable review package.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Lua execution while producing media-bound package proof.

diagnostics.message: Lua execution is forbidden for Goal 055.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replace PNG staged bytes with malformed data.

diagnostics.message: PNG files require valid signature, dimensions and chunk CRC proof.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replace WAV staged bytes with malformed data.

diagnostics.message: WAV files require a valid RIFF/WAVE PCM header and data chunk.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove Goal 054 materialized media source artifacts before loading.
Stage media without Goal 054 materialization/review trace.

diagnostics.message: Every staged file requires a source Goal 054 review/materialization trace.

scenarios.causalMutation: Delete a staged package media file after manifest creation.

diagnostics.message: Every staged media record must resolve to a physical package file.

scenarios.causalMutation: Shuffle source, staged or manifest ordering.

diagnostics.message: All Goal 055 records must be deterministically ordered.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, network, LLM or RAG execution.

diagnostics.message: Provider, network, LLM and RAG calls are forbidden.
Runtime, UI and public GamePackage schema mutation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Modify staged bytes after recording source/staged SHA-256.

diagnostics.message: Staged hash must match source Goal 054 bytes.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim broad Unity build/player/entrypoint mutation outside a narrow loader.

diagnostics.message: Broad Unity mutation is forbidden for Goal 055.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use an absolute path or path traversal in staged package records.

diagnostics.message: Staged media paths must be safe relative paths.
